title: Restored local browser authentication connection
summary: The configured local authentication API on port 3002 was stopped. Restarted the existing managed development launcher; database verification, API reachability and browser login checks pass.

changes.detail: Operational recovery: restarted the existing API at 127.0.0.1:3002 and Expo web at localhost:8081. No authentication bypass, credentials change, learning-data reset or application logic change.

validation.name: Configuration and database
validation.detail: Existing startup check verified owner authentication configuration and session database.

validation.name: Local services and browser CORS
validation.detail: API returns expected unauthenticated 401 JSON; app returns 200. Headless Edge displays password login form and successfully reaches the API cross-origin.

validation.name: Authentication tests
validation.detail: 15 tests passed across API-origin, OwnerGate recovery and session state machine.

validation.name: User session
validation.detail: No password entered and no real user session changed. Existing browser should Retry; an expired session may require signing in. Local servers must remain running.
